page_title: Wave Subs — 看片找不到字幕？本地 AI 帮你生成并翻译

summary.name: Wave Subs
summary.one_liner: A free, open-source desktop app that generates SRT/ASS subtitles from video files with local AI (whisper.cpp) and translates them locally, without uploading anything.
use_cases: Creating subtitles for a movie or show with no existing subtitle file
Translating subtitles into another language locally
Batch-generating subtitles for a full TV season
Keeping video files private by avoiding online subtitle uploads
Editing timing and text of generated subtitles
summary.what_it_does: Wave Subs takes a video (MKV, MP4, MOV, TS, AVI and similar, or audio-only files), recognizes speech with whisper.cpp on the local machine with automatic language detection, and aligns timestamps to speech activity. It translates the dialogue into one of 29 target languages using a local Qwen3 model by default, or an OpenAI-compatible API if configured, and exports SRT or ASS files (bilingual or translation-only). It also includes a subtitle editor with audio preview per line, a glossary for consistent names, and a quality-check note per file; on macOS it can also translate on-screen text such as signs using the system OCR. Embedded text subtitle tracks are used directly when present.
notable: Fully local: recognition, alignment, translation and export run on your machine; works offline after model download
Open source and free with no account, usage limits or paid tier
Bundled ffmpeg and whisper.cpp; decodes codecs like HEVC and DTS
Optional on-screen text translation on macOS using system OCR
caveats: Intel Macs are not supported; macOS requires Apple Silicon for practical speed
Windows recognition runs on CPU and is much slower than on Apple Silicon Macs
Windows build is not code-signed, so SmartScreen warns on first run
Cloud translation via a third-party provider is optional and billed by that provider
